up: Retrieve all compounds associated with the document having ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1240340'. For each compound, return the compound ChEMBL ID, compound preferred name, maximum phase of development, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Do not apply any ranking or row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1240340'
